Plot a mort_data object

Source: R/methods.R
plot.mort_data.Rd

Plot a mort_data object

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mort_data'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("heatmap", "age_profile", "trend"),
  group = 1L,
  years = NULL,
  ages = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A mort_data object.

type

One of "heatmap" (Lexis surface), "age_profile" (log-mx vs age for selected years), or "trend" (log-mx vs year for selected ages).

group

Integer index of the group to plot (default 1).

years

Integer vector of years to highlight (for "age_profile"). Defaults to 4 evenly-spaced years.

ages

Integer vector of age starts to highlight (for "trend"). Defaults to every other age group.

...

Ignored.

Value

A ggplot object (invisibly).
